animations.notes: Modern Webflow sites may use IX3/GSAP (html.w-mod-ix3) instead of IX2 (html.w-mod-ix). Check html class to determine which system is active. GSAP served from cdn.prod.website-files.com/gsap/.

quirks.description: Webflow sites have three common body structures: flat (body > section*N), Client-First wrapped (body > .page-wrapper > main.main-wrapper > section*N), and semantic main (body > main > section*N). The structure depends on the template/framework used.
quirks.workaround: Use spaContainerHints to try .page-wrapper > .main-wrapper, main#main, and main before falling back to body > *.

quirks.description: Webflow has two animation systems: legacy IX2 (html.w-mod-ix, data-w-id triggers) and modern IX3/GSAP (html.w-mod-ix3, GSAP + ScrollTrigger/SplitText). Some sites use both.
quirks.workaround: Check html class for w-mod-ix vs w-mod-ix3 to determine which system is active. For IX3 sites, look for GSAP timeline data instead of IX2 interaction data.

quirks.description: Client-First utility classes (padding-global, container-large, spacer-*) are used by many professional Webflow sites but are NOT universal. Some sites use w-container or bare class names.
quirks.workaround: Only apply Client-First wrapper mappings when those classes are detected on the page. Fall back to extracting computed styles for non-Client-First sites.

quirks.description: Some background-image URLs from cdn.prod.website-files.com return HTTP 403.
quirks.workaround: Skip 403 URLs. Use Playwright screenshot fallback for those elements.

quirks.description: Modern Webflow component variants generate w-variant-{uuid} classes and data-wf--*--variant attributes. Class names are opaque UUIDs whose purpose cannot be inferred from the name.
quirks.workaround: Extract computed styles for elements with w-variant-* classes rather than trying to map class names to purposes.

quirks.description: Every Webflow site loads jQuery 3.5.1 from d3e54v103j8qbb.cloudfront.net. The ?site= query parameter contains the site ID.
quirks.workaround: Use this as a reliable detection signal. Do not include jQuery in the migrated site.

localSite.sectionSelector: body > header, body > nav, main > *, body > footer
